=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:Lines 19-54, 76-97 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper does not validate the workflow repository or push destinations before hiding or restoring credentials, so an editor-changed GitHub destination can receive GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: The origin is accepted based on its GitHub URL prefix without checking GITHUB_REPOSITORY, pushurl, or pushInsteadOf; severity is BLOCKER across reviewers.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:Lines 85-93 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore uses the marker's original generic extraheader key instead of scoping the restored credential to the verified repository origin.
  WHY: The generic key can send authorization to other GitHub endpoints, and the tests expect an origin-scoped key.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:Line 56 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits silently when the marker is missing, but the regression test requires `reason=marker_missing` in stderr.
  WHY: The test's stderr assertion fails because the helper exits without emitting the diagnostic.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:Lines 19-28, 57-60, 98-102 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide and restore failure paths return success, including cases where credential hiding or restoration fails.
  WHY: Workflow callers rely on a nonzero status to stop under `set -e`, but continue when this helper reports success; severity is BLOCKER across reviewers.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:Lines 76-97 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore injects credentials into earlier checkouts before validating every checkout in the marker.
  WHY: If a later checkout has been tampered with or redirected, credentials may already have been restored to an earlier checkout; reviewers disagreed on severity (MAJOR versus BLOCKER), so the highest severity is used.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:Lines 483-488 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: With `--repo` and a bare branch refspec, `_push_targets` drops the refspec and checks HEAD instead of the branch being pushed.
  WHY: A push of a merged branch can be permitted when HEAD is not merged.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:Lines 483-488 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: With `--repo` and a bare branch refspec, `_push_targets` drops the refspec and checks HEAD instead of the branch being pushed.
  WHY: A push of a merged branch can be permitted when HEAD is not merged.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:Lines 483-488 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An unresolved push destination can reach `query_pull_requests` and raise instead of returning the expected ask decision.
  WHY: The test stubs `query_pull_requests` to fail, so the guard propagates the exception rather than returning code=0 with the expected `permissionDecision=ask`.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:Lines 38-41 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workspace transfer filter excludes changes to `scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh`.
  WHY: The verified support commit lacks the exemption, so editor changes to that path are stripped and the autofix run terminates with `editor_empty_noop`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh hide and restore functions
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The committed script does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY, origin identity, pushurl, or pushInsteadOf; restores extraheaders under the marker's original key; and exits 0 on failure paths. The test suite in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py asserts these behaviors.
- requirement: "Pass allowlisted, structured diagnostics rather than raw log instructions to the editor; run it without credentials or network access and enforce automated issue-scoped write restrictions."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The script exits 0 on failure paths, so the editor can proceed when credential hiding fails.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Line 102 (`exit 0` is unconditional) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper always exits 0 regardless of whether hide or restore succeeded or failed.
  WHY: Callers proceed silently after credential failures, and tests expecting nonzero failure statuses fail.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Lines 77-83 (restore origin) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any `https://github.com/` origin without verifying the repository slug.
  WHY: It can inject the token into an editor-changed GitHub repository.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Lines 85-92 (extraheader restore) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore uses the original generic extraheader key instead of scoping it to the verified repository URL.
  WHY: The test expects an origin-scoped key, which is not restored.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Line 56 (`[ -s "${marker}" ] || exit 0`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore exits without stderr diagnostics when called before hide.
  WHY: The regression test expects `reason=marker_missing` in stderr.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Lines 19-28 (hide function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide does not validate repository identity or push destinations and exits successfully for existing or uncreatable markers.
  WHY: Tests expect rejection of an existing marker, explicit pushurl, and pushInsteadOf configurations.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: Lines 76-97 (restore sequential processing) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Restore may inject credentials into an earlier checkout before discovering a later checkout is tampered with or redirected.
  WHY: Validation happens sequentially, so a later failure can leave credentials in an earlier checkout.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only." (agents.md:214-222, README.md:1404-1416)
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  Evidence of absence: The committed 102-line script exits 0 unconditionally (line 102). The hide function (lines 19-54) never checks GITHUB_REPOSITORY identity, pushurl, or pushInsteadOf. The restore function (lines 55-101) never verifies the repository slug against the workflow repository, never validates push destinations, never scopes extraheaders to the verified origin, and exits 0 on missing GH_TOKEN and stale markers. The test suite in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py has at least 10 test functions that assert these behaviors and will fail against the current script.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 77-84 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any GitHub origin and does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY or push destinations.
  WHY: The workflow token may be sent to an external repository.

  WHY: The assertion fails because stderr is empty.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 485-488 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With `remote_provided` true and a bare branch name, `_push_targets` drops the refspec.
  WHY: The guard inspects HEAD instead of the named branch and may permit a push of merged history; the identical defect exists in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:485-488.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 21-27, 57-60, 98-102 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide and restore failure branches exit 0.
  WHY: Workflow callers under `set -e` continue after credential hiding or restoration fails.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py: lines 38-41 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The review autofix workspace transfer filter excludes `scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh`.
  WHY: Changes to the helper are stripped, causing the autofix run to terminate with `editor_empty_noop`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only.
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh hide and restore functions
  Evidence of absence: The committed 102-line version of scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh does not check GITHUB_REPOSITORY, accepts any origin starting with https://github.com/, ignores remote.origin.pushurl and pushInsteadOf, does not scope extraheaders to the verified repository URL, exits 0 on all failure paths, and validates checkouts sequentially while modifying them rather than validating all checkouts before restoring credentials. The 11 contract tests in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py asserting these behaviors fail against the committed script.

  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
